title: Owner requests 2026-10-25/26: mood, framed story moments, a readable HUD and settings, characters with a signature, and an opening that hooks (Cổ Tiên Lộ survey; D-077, D-078)
source: owner message of 2026-10-25 (Vietnamese) with the Cổ Tiên Lộ survey; the measured gap is in .claude/skills/aetheria-visual-craft/references/AESTHETIC_VISION.md (play area saturation 0.29 vs 0.15, centre/all 1.20 vs 1.35, warm 2.0 % below the DNA band)

items.title: World mood layer: muted ground, light pulled to the centre, mist, one warm practical
items.objective: The hub (Thôn Lạc Hà) stops reading as one evenly lit mid-green field. Through the existing ambience seam (src/presentation/ambient/: MapAmbience, AmbienceProfileData, data/ambience/*.tres, chosen by WorldRuntime from the story beat) give the authored default ambience a grade that mutes the ground, a soft falloff toward the frame edges, slow drifting mist or motes, and at least one warm practical light, so the eye goes to the player and the actors pop. Measured on the real capture's play area (top 22 % and bottom 18 % cut): mean saturation from 0.29 down to <= 0.23, centre/whole luminance from 1.20 up to >= 1.28, warm-pixel share inside the DNA band 3-22 %, and the player sprite still clearly separated from the ground.
in_scope: src/presentation/ambient/** and the hub's ambience profile data under data/ambience/**
a presentation-only overlay (edge falloff, mist/motes) that never draws over HUD and never blocks input

a measuring script tools/aetheria_art_pipeline/validate/mood_metrics.py (stdlib + PIL, /usr/bin/python3) that prints the metrics of .claude/skills/aetheria-visual-craft/references/AESTHETIC_VISION.md for a capture
before/after captures vi 1280x720 and en 1280x800, metrics recorded in docs/VISUAL_CRAFT_WORKFLOW.md or the handoff
a unit test for the profile/overlay invariants (tint never below MapAmbience.MIN_TINT_LEVEL, _process off when steady)
out_of_scope: tile or sprite palette changes (Visual DNA; owner gate ART-DIR-02 is about a BRIGHTER world and is not touched)
tasks: load .claude/skills/aetheria-visual-craft (section 0 and references/AESTHETIC_VISION.md) and follow it
measure the current hub capture with the new script and record the before numbers
extend the default hub ambience: grade, edge falloff, mist/motes, one warm practical; story ambiences keep working
re-capture, re-measure, iterate until the targets hold; look at 1x and magnified
tests, docs, before/after numbers
constraints: presentation holds no truth: nothing saved, no clock read, no rule asks the layer anything
idle cost near zero: no per-frame allocation; _process only while something moves (mist may run, but bounded and measured)
boss or danger telegraphs and the HUD are never darkened or hidden by the layer
the final look is the owner's call: report before/after captures and numbers, not 'looks better'

acceptance_criteria.text: on the hub gameplay capture the play-area saturation is <= 0.23, centre/whole luminance >= 1.28 and the warm share inside 3-22 %, measured by the committed script with before and after numbers recorded
the layer is presentation only, rides the existing ambience seam, holds no truth and costs nothing when steady
HUD, dialogue and danger cues are never darkened or covered; both aspect ratios look right at real size
world, player and story flows pass with no SCRIPT ERROR or leak

items.title: Framed story moments: a dialogue frame in Aetheria's own motif, name plates, the HUD gives way
items.objective: Talking to someone feels like a story moment, not a slate text box. The dialogue panel (src/presentation/dialogue/) gets a material frame in Aetheria's OWN motif through UITheme roles (no parchment, scroll or jade look taken from the reference), the speaker shown clearly (name plate, and the portrait when one exists), and while a dialogue is open the non-essential HUD dims so the scene and the frame carry the moment. NPCs who can talk or give a quest show a small world-space name plate near them. Whole-text rules of ui-01 stay.
in_scope: a world-space name plate for talk/quest NPCs under src/presentation/
out_of_scope: new portraits (use what the pipeline already ships)
minimap or new HUD elements beyond the name plate
tasks: load .claude/skills/aetheria-visual-craft and .claude/skills/aetheria-ui-localization
design the frame and plate as theme roles, measure against the HUD 15 % budget
implement, keeping keyboard/Esc behaviour
tests: nothing clipped (ui-01 layout test stays green), HUD dimmed only while open, plates only on talk/quest NPCs
captures and docs
constraints: HUD <= 15 % while exploring; the dialogue band stays where UI_UX_BIBLE puts it
UI never drives gameplay truth
no copied asset or kit; every new asset through the pipeline with an ASSET_LICENSES row

acceptance_criteria.text: the dialogue frame and name plates use UITheme roles in Aetheria's own motif, with no reference asset or kit copied
while a dialogue is open the non-essential HUD is dimmed and restored on close; nothing in the dialogue is clipped in vi or en
name plates show only on NPCs who can talk or give a quest and stay within the HUD budget
captures at vi 1280x720 and en 1280x800 show an open dialogue and a plated NPC, readable at real size

items.title: An identity plaque nothing covers, and a story banner when a task begins
items.objective: The HUD reads like a finished game: the identity plaque (portrait, name, realm, HP and other OWNED gauges) is one framed block in Aetheria's motif that no panel, quest line or dialogue ever overlaps, at both aspect ratios; and when the quest system starts a new task the screen shows a short hanging banner (task name plus one line in the protagonist's voice, both locale keys) that fades in about 2 s and never blocks input. Read .claude/skills/aetheria-ui-localization ('Lessons from a released tu-tiên game').
in_scope: locale keys vi+en for banner lines of the existing quests (one line each, in the protagonist's voice, no canon change)
out_of_scope: quest rules or data beyond the banner line key
new gauges for state no system owns

frame the plaque, enforce a reserved band
banner on the existing quest-started signal
tests + captures + docs
constraints: HUD <= 15 % while exploring
presentation listens to existing signals; it decides nothing
UITheme roles and layout tokens only

acceptance_criteria.text: no panel, quest line or dialogue overlaps the identity plaque at 1280x720 or 1280x800, asserted by a test that opens every panel

captures in both languages show the framed plaque and a banner, readable at real size

items.title: Settings in tabs with presets, a story-reading mode, text size and key rebinding

Settings persist through the existing settings owner.

items.title: Characters with a signature: one defining shape each and value contrast against the floor (D-077)
items.objective: Per D-077, every player look and every named NPC in the hub reads at 1x like the survey's figures: each has ONE signature silhouette item or shape that no other character shares (hat, blade on the back, long dark hair, staff, veil…), clothing whose mean value separates from the hub floor by a measured margin, and cleaner pixels (a deterministic cleanup rule in pixelize, never hand-edited PNGs). Built only through the pipeline at 32x48; iterate with `blender/cli.py --only` (skill aetheria-art-pipeline) and finish with one full render per actor. Rebuild lin_yue, te_moc, ko_than and shen_buqi so the min_tone contour debt closes.
in_scope: tools/aetheria_art_pipeline/** design data, props3d/geometry for signature items, pixelize rules
regenerated sheets and anchors the game loads
a readability test extension: a distinct signature per character and floor contrast
tasks: load aetheria-visual-craft (§0 incl. 'Characters with a signature') and aetheria-art-pipeline
measure every hub character's floor contrast and silhouette overlap
design one signature per character, build via pipeline with the --only loop
rebuild the four NPCs with contour debt
tests, captures, docs
constraints: lossless indexed PNGs via pngout
deterministic: two builds give the same md5
run --import after pixel before any Godot test (stale-import trap)

acceptance_criteria.text: each player look and named hub NPC has a signature shape no other character shares, asserted by a test on the sheets
every character's clothing separates from the hub floor by the measured margin recorded in the test
before/after real-hub captures at 1x show the characters reading clearly; built by the pipeline, deterministic, pngout
player, NPC and story flows pass with no SCRIPT ERROR or leak

items.title: PROPOSAL: the first ten minutes re-staged per D-078 (hook, protagonist voice, a first choice whose consequence is seen)
items.objective: Write docs/proposals/STORY_OPENING_TADE_PROPOSAL.md: a PROPOSAL (not canon) that re-stages the existing opening (Origins, Lạc Hà arrival) so that, within five minutes, the player meets a hook scene, hears the protagonist's own cold, calculating voice (sample lines vi + en), and makes a first real choice whose consequence is visible later (who remembers, what opens or closes, how standing moves), all read from persistent state per NARRATIVE_MASTER_PLAN §3 (no meter). Include a milestone map: Aetheria act/reveal-ladder slots against the novel's archetypal arc beats (betrayal, fall, rebirth, rising through schemes) described only in our own summary words, with a column the owner fills with the novel milestone each one echoes. Every quest in the opening is written as a scheme (goal, two or more approaches, the price of each). No novel names, places or sentences.
in_scope: docs/CONTRADICTION_REGISTER.md and NARRATIVE_MASTER_PLAN clue references if the proposal finds a conflict (as notes, not edits to canon)
out_of_scope: editing story data, locale or canon docs (owner acceptance first)
